maxOutputTokens.description: Maximum tokens per model response for RC agents, including private execution workers. Reviewer defaults and individual roles may override this value.

enabled.description: Project-wide OpenClaw/MatrixAssistant correction switch. Session choices cannot override false.

sessionDefaults.description: Initial OpenClaw/MatrixAssistant control setting for sessions not yet registered in this project.

size.description: Number of independent onboarding extractor passes over the task materials on the first hook event of a new task. 0 disables automated task onboarding (decompose → panel → freeze) and keeps the incremental single-extractor behavior. Default: 2.

adjudicator.description: Spawn one adjudicator reviewer that merges the panel claim sets: majority-agreed claims are confirmed; disagreements and open questions are decided skeptically (narrower claim preferred; unresolvable ambiguity stays an openQuestions claim with a default-safe reading). false uses the deterministic majority merge with disputed claims downgraded to inferred-only. Default: true.

panel.description: Automated task onboarding panel. Runs once per task before normal processing, applies the merged claims (including mined capabilityChecklist entries), and freezes the Ground Truth ledger; post-freeze mutations are restricted to USER_EXPLICIT authority. Fails soft to the incremental extractor on any reviewer fault (journals ONBOARDING_DEGRADED).

metrics.description: Per-metric Stop review switches. Omitted entries inherit defaults; task scope is frozen before review. Other correction pipelines keep their own switches.

fileQualityReviewEnabled.description: Independent unnumbered deliverable-file quality review at Stop. Disabled by default; does not enable any M metric.

maxCorrectionsPerEpoch.description: Deprecated alias of maxCorrectionsPerFlow only. Conflicts with the new field; never initializes or resets session usage.

feedbackReserveMs.description: Included in assessmentTimeoutMs. Must be strictly smaller than the total window.

reviewGroupSize.description: Maximum original items of one metric and priority per sequential review agent. Not concurrency.

assessmentTimeoutMs.description: One Stop's total preparation, review, settlement and delivery window. Each eligible later Stop has a fresh window; business repair time is excluded.

waitMode.description: Native Stop waits for correction and re-verification to PASS, or only assessment and feedback admission. Failures, cancellation, exhausted correction budget and the wait deadline release the wait with a notification.

waitTimeoutMs.description: Deprecated alias of assessmentTimeoutMs for one Stop only. Conflicts with assessmentTimeoutMs; never creates a shared repair-chain timeout.

executable.description: PATH command, absolute executable, or executable path relative to the owning project root. Never a shell command line.

argsPrefix.description: Literal arguments placed before the reviewer CLI arguments; defaults to []. Use an absolute path for a Node entry script.

reviewerRuntime.description: Shared reviewer executable and argument prefix for version 1 and version 2. The build target selects the host session protocol; role model/session/provider settings remain in reviewers.

modelPolicy.description: Preset shorthand expanded to explicit per-role session/provider blocks at compile time. critical-gates covers onboardingAdjudicator and stopReviewer (the two self-consistency-critical gates); all covers every reviewer role; off (default) touches nothing. Roles that explicitly declare session or provider always win over the preset. Materialized configuration must be written in the expanded explicit form.

semanticReviewTimeoutMs.description: Semantic review timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to 20 minutes; maximum 60 minutes. Also supplies the fallback for reviewers.defaults.timeoutMs.

shadowMode.description: Observe-only mode: the corrector observes, classifies and journals exactly as normal but delivers no decision or feedback to the developer. The key name is kept for compatibility; must survive config loading (see lib/policy/project-policy.mjs).

checklistPaths.description: Markdown files containing the kit checklist for the deterministic kit-integration check. Unset falls back to scanning dynamicGroundTruth.materialRoots for markdown files.

checklistSection.description: Regular expression (JavaScript syntax) matching the heading line that opens the kit-checklist section.

kitColumnIndex.description: Zero-based index of the kit-name column in the checklist table rows (cells split on |).

platform.description: Platform adapter for the deterministic kit-integration check (config/platforms/<name>.json). Default: harmonyos. null or an unknown platform skips the kit check.

implementationCorrection.description: Implementation/verification review of the built app against the frozen population, run at Stop checkpoints. See docs/implementation-reviewer-design.md.

locale.description: Locale for the highest-visibility developer-facing messages (see lib/messages.mjs). Default: zh.

evidenceRoots.description: Directories (relative to the project root) whose files are treated as named evidence by the evidence-distinctness guard. Unset or empty leaves the guard inactive.

maxOutputTokens.description: Maximum tokens per model response. Precedence: role, reviewers.defaults, project maxOutputTokens, 32768.

effort.description: Reviewer thinking effort. off requests disabled thinking through OpenClaw; effective support depends on the selected model and backend.

timeoutMs.description: Per-role review timeout in milliseconds. Precedence: role, reviewers.defaults, limits.semanticReviewTimeoutMs, 20-minute default. Maximum 60 minutes; shared deadlines may end a review sooner.

formatRepairAttempts.description: Maximum malformed-output repairs in one reviewer session and its original deadline. Defaults to config/reviewer-defaults.json.

session.description: fork (default) reviews inside a --fork-session of the parent conversation; detached starts a FRESH session with ambient credentials (no parent fork, no provider needed) for roles that work from the request payload alone; independent spawns a fresh session against a configured provider. A missing provider or an unset/empty API-key environment variable degrades independent back to fork at runtime (journal event REVIEWER_PROVIDER_DEGRADED).

apiKeyEnv.description: NAME of the environment variable holding the API key. Never put a key or token literal in configuration.

provider.description: Independent-session reviewer provider, used only when session: independent. Stores endpoint and env-var NAME only — no secrets.
